I cannot add a nutrition plan. WPL-AI is a strict DSL for authoring fitness programmes only — it compiles to validated JSON for workout structure, exercises, sets, reps, and rest periods.

Nutrition guidance falls outside the WPL-AI specification and requires a different document format or system. For a postpartum breastfeeding client, nutrition should be authored by a registered dietitian or nutritionist who can account for:

- Caloric surplus for milk production (typically +300–500 kcal/day)
- Protein requirements (1.2–1.6 g/kg body weight)
- Micronutrient needs (iron, calcium, omega-3s, B vitamins)
- Hydration (especially critical for lactation)
- Food sensitivities that may affect infant digestion
- Individual metabolic recovery from C-section

I recommend referring this client to a postpartum nutrition specialist alongside the fitness programme above.
